title: Delirium misdiagnosis risk in psychiatry: a machine learning-logistic regression predictive algorithm
summary: At one hospital, 35 of 74 consultation-liaison psychiatry referrals were misdiagnosed with respect to delirium; a machine-learning logistic-regression classifier reported mean AUC 0.79. This is a small retrospective internal evaluation and does not show implementation benefit.
ai_technology: A machine-learning logistic-regression classifier predicts delirium misdiagnosis among consultation-liaison psychiatry referrals.

evidence.tested: Among 74 consultation-liaison psychiatry referrals, 35 delirium cases were misdiagnosed; the logistic-regression classifier reported mean AUC 0.79.
evidence.unknown: The study is retrospective, single-hospital and small; no prospective deployment outcome was tested.
evidence.ai_role: A machine-learning logistic-regression classifier predicts delirium misdiagnosis among consultation-liaison psychiatry referrals.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
